app.name: WiiCam test
app.short_description: Test build for WiiCam issues #1 and #4
app.long_description:
A test build for WiiCam. It installs as its own app and doesn't replace WiiCam.
Issue #1: cameras with more than 2,048 bytes of USB descriptors, like the Logitech C920, can be listed. If it ever says "Camera not found - replug it", unplug the camera, plug it back in and press A. Test 4 keeps more of the C920's frames, accepts its stereo microphone, and logs why frames are dropped. Down on the menu switches to the largest USB packets, for testing.
Issues #2 and #3: videos carry their Huffman tables and end each frame exactly, so the Photo Channel can play them.
Issue #4: test 4 carries on when a microphone doesn't report its sample rate, and logs each step of the microphone setup.
Please share SD:/wc04-camera/session.log on the issue.
